items.text:
I bought this game with some uncertainty but after buying I just got immediately sucked in and am loving every part of it. The game is a bit rough around the edges but at the price it is a total no-brainer to buy it if you are interested in the genre! I just keep going, can't stop scavenging and am looking forward to making my ship the best it can be. 

I will note that some of the rough edges I hope will be improved are:
- UI Scaling
- Smoother Ultrawide Support
- Improved space map interaction (often click it and it just drifts off to the abyss)

Otherwise I am just loving the systems and the world even just having scratched the surface feels rich and rewarding. Looking forward to sinking many hours into this!
items.text_zh:
我买这游戏时还有点犹豫，但买完之后立刻就被吸进去了，每个部分我都很喜欢。游戏确实有些粗糙，但以这个价格来说，如果你对这个类型感兴趣，那买它完全不用犹豫！我就是停不下来，一直搜刮，期待着把我的飞船打造成最好的样子。

我要指出，我希望一些粗糙之处能得到改进：
- UI缩放
- 更流畅的超宽屏支持
- 改进的太空地图交互（经常点了它就直接飘向深渊）

除此之外，我真的很喜欢这些系统和这个世界，哪怕只是刚摸到皮毛，也感觉内容丰富又有回报。期待投入很多小时进去！

items.text:
This game is half baked. 
- spend 2 hours scrapping a derilect jsut to get back to the station and the crap vendor wont buy your scrap. 
- Walking around and all of a sudden your character goes invisible.
- Flying and all of a sudden for no reason yo go from 150m vsec to none, no impact no collision nothing!
- character creation please for the love of god tell me how you get tendonitis from reporting to the cops?
         This game may have a bunch of RNG but ffs at least let the RNG make damn sense.
- Tutorial tells you go to do something yet dont even give the location when you hover over the tut req. half of them work half dont.

Honestly early access or not this ♥♥♥♥♥ crazy to even be in any sort of released state cause the damn games unplayable in its current condition. Save your money and buy a different game. seriously this game feels half assed and poorly thought through.
items.text_zh:
这游戏是半成品。
- 花了2个小时拆解一艘废弃船，结果回到空间站后，那个破自动售货机还不买你的废料。
- 四处走动时，你的角色突然就隐形了。
- 飞行时，突然毫无理由地从150米/秒变成零，没有撞击、没有碰撞，什么都没有！
- 角色创建，求求你了，告诉我你是怎么因为向警察报到而得了肌腱炎的？
         这游戏可能有一堆随机数生成，但拜托了，至少让随机数生成有点道理吧。
- 教程告诉你去做什么，但当你把鼠标悬停在教程要求上时，甚至不给你位置。一半能用，一半不能用。

老实说，不管是不是抢先体验，这♥♥♥♥♥能处于任何形式的发布状态都太疯狂了，因为这破游戏在当前状态下根本没法玩。省下你的钱，去买别的游戏吧。说真的，这游戏感觉是敷衍了事、考虑不周。

items.text:
[13 hours] 

I really love the concept of this game, but the execution of it kinda sucks.

There's effectively 5 resources:
Air, Fuel, Power, Money, and Storage. 

If you run out of any of the first four, that's end game - makes sense... but is there some kind of UI that gives you a status on these things in one place? Na. For AIR you can right click until you get empty ground or "compartment" readout on the specific zone by zone - no heatmapping that I've found.. For FUEL you can uhhh right click on the Nav Station, USE the nav station, go to the nav interface and look... For POWER you right click on a battery and click "control panel" where it will tell you on a battery by battery basis - heck maybe there is some super simple way to view all these things but it doesn't really matter if the user is never given instructions on how to use them! Oh yeah, for each of those things, you can't just right click on the item, your character has to physically go there to interact. I have TPMS sensors in my car, so my current HUD has Air and Fuel - pretty sure at the point this game is supposed to be at they could figure that kind of thing out. After looking online about "wtf is wrong with this game" I discovered I could push "F1" and disable fog of war. WOW! Game changer, I can click on my destination instead of just getting "CAN'T GO THERE" errors from the darkness - these kinds of basic human usability concepts seem to be totally out of place here. Does the game tutorial instruct you on how to swap out fuel/air/batteries? Na. BETTER NOT RUN OUT AND NEED A SPARE OR ANYTHING.

I recently ran out of charge - so I go online, find out this game has a transit system you can call to shuttle you to base and back after you purchase a charged battery! AWESOME! I go to base, buy a battery which says it has 100% charge - shuttle back to the ship and install the battery: no charge. 
GUESS I'LL DIE

Bonus! You can be having a killer playthrough and it just decides when you re-load it that 'something isn't placed right' and now your ship will never pressurize again! Sucks for however long you spent to get there!

My favorite is desperately trying to get the character to not automatically run into vacuum with no helmet on because they're determined to install a floor tile somewhere outside the ship. There is no "Just hold still until I explicitly tell you what to do" button like "drafting" in rimworld, there's just "The second I stop micromanaging these idiots will go do SOMETHING" - the autotask button apparently means "make up new tasks" which is cool, but there's no obvious way to just DO NOTHING. JUST STAND THERE FOR A SECOND BRO.  

I feel less like I'm playing a game, than I'm fighting against the game itself - I want to be fighting the unforgiving universe, not dying in a futuristic world that forgot how to make solar panels, visible fuel representations, "emergency power"... I REALLY like the concept and "git gud" is a totally valid response to this review - as a n00b however this game is an effing miserable experience haha

[30 hours in]

I have redundant EVERYTHING. Space is harsh - even with no direct ship combat there's a million things to maintain. I've managed to add another room to my ship, find and eliminate the random air leaks, and found where to buy an EVA suit allowing a WILDLY more pleasant gameplay loop. This game is HUGE. I'm barely even scratching the surface with my shipbreaking - there's cargo trade and whole other planets? 

There are bugs. My character got stuck "bashing" a floor tile any time I wasn't micromanaging their actions - it didn't show up in "Tasks" until I saved, closed the game, loaded the save. 

This game doesn't have a learning curve, it has a learning 90 degree turn. 

I am loving everything about this so far, except all the parts I hate ;)
items.text_zh:
[13小时]

我真的很喜欢这个游戏的概念，但它的执行方式有点糟糕。

实际上有5种资源：
空气、燃料、电力、金钱和存储空间。

如果你用完了前四种中的任何一种，那就是游戏结束——这很合理……但是有没有某种UI能在一个地方给你这些资源的状况？没有。对于空气，你可以右键点击直到得到空地或特定区域的“隔间”读数——逐区域进行——我没有找到任何热力图。对于燃料，你可以呃……右键点击导航站，使用导航站，进入导航界面然后查看……对于电力，你右键点击电池并点击“控制面板”，它会逐个电池地告诉你——哎呀，也许有某种超级简单的方法来查看所有这些，但如果用户从未被告知如何使用它们，那也无关紧要！哦对了，对于这些东西中的每一个，你不能只是右键点击物品，你的角色必须亲自走到那里才能互动。我的车里有TPMS传感器，所以我当前的HUD上有空气和燃料——很确定在这个游戏应该达到的阶段，他们应该能想出那种东西。在网上搜索了“这个游戏到底出了什么问题”之后，我发现我可以按“F1”来禁用战争迷雾。哇！改变游戏规则，我可以点击我的目的地，而不是仅仅从黑暗中收到“不能去那里”的错误——这些基本的人类可用性概念在这里似乎完全不合时宜。游戏教程有没有指导你如何更换燃料/空气/电池？没有。最好不要用完然后需要一个备用的或什么的。

我最近用完了电量——所以我上网，发现这个游戏有一个交通系统，你可以在购买一块充满电的电池后呼叫它把你穿梭往返基地！太棒了！我去基地，买了一块标称100%电量的电池——穿梭回飞船并安装电池：没有电。
看来我要死了

额外惊喜！你可能正在进行一次超棒的游玩，然后它在你重新加载时决定“某个东西放置不正确”，现在你的飞船将永远无法再增压！不管你花了多长时间到达那里，都糟透了！

我最喜欢的是拼命试图让角色不要自动跑进真空而不戴头盔，因为他们决心要在飞船外面的某个地方安装一块地板砖。没有像《环世界》中的“征召”那样的“就待着别动直到我明确告诉你做什么”按钮，只有“我一停止微观管理这些白痴就会去做某件事”——自动任务按钮显然意味着“编造新任务”，这很酷，但没有明显的方法来只是什么都不做。就站在那里一秒钟，兄弟。

我感觉自己不像是在玩游戏，而是在与游戏本身作斗争——我想与无情的宇宙作斗争，而不是在一个忘记了如何制造太阳能板、可见燃料表示、“应急电源”的未来世界中死去……我真的很喜欢这个概念，而“练好技术”是对这篇评论完全有效的回应——然而作为一个新手，这个游戏是一种极其痛苦的体验哈哈

[30小时]

我所有东西都有冗余。太空是严酷的——即使没有直接的飞船战斗，也有无数的事情需要维护。我设法给我的飞船增加了另一个房间，找到并消除了随机漏气点，并找到了在哪里购买EVA服，从而实现了极其更愉快的游戏循环。这个游戏是巨大的。我在拆船方面才刚刚触及表面——还有货物贸易和整个其他星球？

还有
都是bug。每当我没有微观管理角色的行动时，我的角色就会卡在“猛砸”一块地板砖上——直到我保存、关闭游戏、加载存档后，它才出现在“任务”里。

这款游戏没有学习曲线，它有一个学习90度急转弯。

到目前为止，我喜欢它的一切，除了所有我讨厌的部分 ;)

observations.evidence: there's no obvious way to just DO NOTHING. JUST STAND THERE FOR A SECOND BRO.

items.text:
I docked with a derelict and donned my spacesuit before rushing out the airlock excited to have found my first large ship.  Barely through the airlock a figure emerges from the shadows and says "Well what do we have here?"  A Pirate!  My best combat skills are fragile and feeble and I have no weapon. Sweating bullets I lunged at them at tackled them to the ground. Jumping back to my feet I deliver a series of withering blows I can only imagine look like Mr. Bean attempting to do some judo he saw on tv as the feed shows "Your attacks did not affect the enemy armor"  Winded now I demand their surrender.  Shockingly the pirate accepts!  I see now that they are temporarily a member of my crew.  Switching to the pirate and opening their inventory there is a gun in one hand and a katana in the other.  Realizing how lucky I just got I have the pirate surrender their weapons as well as their suit helmet to the floor.  

I love the storytelling style of this game 10/10 would watch pirates expire in hard vacuum again.
items.text_zh:
我与一艘废弃飞船对接，穿上宇航服，然后冲出气闸，兴奋于找到了我的第一艘大型飞船。刚穿过气闸，一个身影就从阴影中冒出来，说道：“看看我们这儿有什么？”一个海盗！我最擅长的战斗技能是脆弱而虚弱的，而且我没有武器。我汗如雨下，扑向他们，把他们扑倒在地。我跳回双脚站立，打出一连串我只能在想象中看起来像憨豆先生试图做他在电视上看到的柔道那样的凌厉打击，而信息流显示“你的攻击没有影响敌人的护甲”。现在气喘吁吁的我要求他们投降。令人震惊的是，海盗接受了！我现在看到他们暂时成了我船员的一员。切换到海盗并打开他们的物品栏，一只手有枪，另一只手有武士刀。意识到我刚才有多幸运，我让海盗把他们的武器以及宇航服头盔都交出来放到地上。

我喜欢这款游戏的叙事风格，10/10，还会再看海盗在硬真空中丧命。

observations.description: 近战攻击对敌人护甲无效
observations.evidence: Your attacks did not affect the enemy armor
observations.evidence_zh: 你的攻击没有影响敌人的护甲

items.text:
I've played this for about a hundred hours and I've had a lot of fun. I got my moneys worth out of it. That being said I probably wouldn't recommend buying it in current state. I have a few problems with it at the state it's in.

One, a lot of bugs. Loading/unloading large ships with multiple crewmembers breaks sometimes. I take the tram on one crewmember to level 2 of the station, do my stuff, take the tram back, my ship is no longer docked, my character has not traveled back to level 1, and the game is softlocked. Or the room bug where sometimes, randomly, your ship will just depressurize and fail to hold pressure until you uninstall and reinstall a wall in your ship. Or when the police won't interact with me after they force dock to inspect my ship, I undock, and they declare me resisting arrest. The bugs make what's a really good framework just unplayable.

Two, building a ship is tedious. The game progression of this is that you get handed a dumpster of a ship and a pile of debt, and you go scrapping to spruce your ship up with salvaged parts and sell your stuff. Eventually you get a large enough ship, build a reactor, and go travel the solar system since your reactor can propell you to everywhere else. I never got beyond the starting asteroid (to be fair you don't NEED to) to go explore Venus (the next main area) because of the bugs and the fact that making my ship the way I wanted it to be making felt like a job. I could just be a perfectionist but I just kind of dropped the game because it felt like work getting my ship to be the way I wanted it to be. 

The AI is not good, you need to babysit your crew or they might do stupid things. Leaving my game at FFW for 30, real life minutes while my guy goes and replaces floor tiles, punctuated every 10 minutes by me babysitting him taking off his suit, putting him on the toilet, taking a drink from a water bottle, and then putting the suit back on, is just bad gameplay and tedious. If you don't do this, your guy could starve, suffocate, or decompress himself or the ship.

Edit: 30 more hours a year later. 

They're still updating and fixing bugs. Most of the bugs I ran into seem to be fixed, and the room depressurization bug has been defined, if not patched. (don't save and reload with blueprints that go through walls or game'll fail to define your room or something) Construction is still tedious, but I know how to play the game and hired crew early on so that's not the end of the world. 

Complaints: AI is still really dumb. My gripe this save is about ship construction. I am a perfectionist and the best parts in the game are these walls and floors made by one specific manufacturer that are extra light, which matter for fuel consumption/efficiency. I go to deconstruct a ship made out of these parts, and put them on my ship. I put build orders on my ship, and deconstruction orders on the ship I'm scrapping. My crew AI will, if not stopped, go and pick up a single floor tile or cable conduit or whatever at a time and bring it back, work on it, and repeat. They have the capacity for ~50. This leads me to micromanage my crew which is annoying with one and impossible with two as I have to shift click a whole bunch of floor tiles. Crew AI will build things in the order that they're selected, which seems to be bottom to top, left to right, which in some cases can cause aggravating pathing, as they'll skip things right next to them and travel to go up to the next block regardless of distance if there is one. 

Crew pathfinding is poorly optimized and causes lots of lag (if you have more than one crew member it will slow your game to a crawl on higher FFW speeds) since they go over each task globally in order of creation and run a check on if they can or can not accomplish that task. 

The clickdrag menu has bounds poorly defined, game is made of tiles, sometimes a row of tiles is missed, most games solve this by having an overlay that pops up that shows which tiles are selected when you're clickdragging. Would be nice to see here. 

There are like, three locations in the game that you can travel to that are unique, the rest of the stations are copy pastes. Bit disappointing. 
/Complaints

I'll change my review to positive since they fixed some major bugs and seem to be committed to taking it all the way.
items.text_zh:
我已经玩了大约一百个小时，玩得非常开心。我觉得这钱花得值。话虽如此，以目前的状态，我大概不会推荐购买。就它现在的状态而言，我有几个问题。

第一，很多bug。装载/卸载有多名船员的大型飞船有时会出问题。我带着一名船员坐电车到空间站2层，办完事，坐电车回来，我的飞船不再停靠了，我的角色没有回到1层，游戏卡死了。或者房间bug，有时会随机出现，你的飞船会突然失压，并且无法保持压力，直到你卸下并重新安装飞船里的一面墙。或者警察强行停靠检查我的飞船后不与我互动，我解除停靠，他们就宣布我拒捕。这些bug让一个本来非常好的框架变得完全没法玩。

第二，建造飞船很繁琐。游戏进程是这样的：你拿到一艘垃圾一样的飞船和一堆债务，然后你去打捞，用回收来的零件把飞船整修一番，再卖掉你的东西。最终你得到一艘足够大的飞船，建造一个反应堆，然后去周游太阳系，因为你的反应堆能把你推进到其他任何地方。因为bug，以及把我飞船改成我想要的样子感觉像上班，我从未离开过起始小行星（公平地说，你并不需要离开）去探索金星（下一个主要区域）。我可能只是个完美主义者，但我还是有点放弃了这个游戏，因为把飞船弄成我想要的样子感觉像在工作。

The AI不好，你需要照看你的船员，否则他们可能会做蠢事。把我的游戏以快进速度放着30个现实分钟，让我的家伙去更换地板砖，每10分钟穿插一次我照看他脱掉宇航服、让他上厕所、从水瓶里喝口水，然后再把宇航服穿回去，这玩法就是糟糕又繁琐。如果你不这么做，你的家伙可能会饿死、窒息，或者把自己或飞船减压。

编辑：一年后又玩了30个小时。

他们仍在更新和修复bug。我遇到的大多数bug似乎都修好了，房间失压bug也已经被定义清楚了，即使还没打补丁。（不要带着穿墙的蓝图保存并重新加载，否则游戏会无法定义你的房间还是什么的）建造仍然繁琐，但我知道怎么玩这个游戏，而且很早就雇了船员，所以那也不是世界末日。

抱怨：AI还是真的很蠢。这次存档我的不满是关于飞船建造的。我是个完美主义者，游戏里最好的部件是某个特定制造商制造的这些墙和地板，它们特别轻，这对燃料消耗/效率很重要。我去拆解一艘由这些部件组成的飞船，把它们放到我的飞船上。我在我的飞船上下达建造命令，在我正在拆解的飞船上下达拆解命令。我的船员AI如果没人阻止，会一次只捡一块地板砖或一根电缆管或随便什么东西带回来，干一会儿，然后重复。他们的搬运容量大约有50。这导致我不得不微观管理我的船员，一个船员时很烦，两个船员时就不可能，因为我得按住Shift点击一大堆地板砖。船员AI会按照它们被选中的顺序建造东西，这个顺序似乎是从下到上、从左到右，这在某些情况下会导致令人恼火的寻路，因为它们会跳过就在旁边的东西，不管距离多远都跑去下一个方块，如果那里有一个的话。

船员寻路优化很差，会导致大量卡顿（如果你有不止一名船员，在较高的快进速度下游戏会慢得像爬一样），因为它们会按创建顺序全局遍历每个任务，并检查它们能否完成该任务。

点击拖拽菜单的边界定义很差，游戏是由方块组成的，有时会漏掉一行方块，大多数游戏解决这个问题的方法是弹出一个覆盖层，在你点击拖拽时显示选中了哪些方块。这里要是也能看到就好了。

游戏里大概有三个可以前往的独特地点，其余的空间站都是复制粘贴的。有点令人失望。
/抱怨

我会把评测改成好评，因为他们修复了一些主要bug，而且似乎决心把它做到底。
如果有的话。

船员寻路优化得很差，会导致大量卡顿（如果你有不止一名船员，在较高的快进速度下游戏会慢得像爬一样），因为他们会按创建顺序全局遍历每个任务，并检查他们能否完成该任务。

点击拖拽菜单的边界定义得很差，游戏是由格子组成的，有时会漏掉一整行格子，大多数游戏解决这个问题的方法是弹出一个覆盖层，在你点击拖拽时显示哪些格子被选中了。在这里能看到这个就好了。

游戏里大概只有三个可以前往的独特地点，其余的站点都是复制粘贴的。有点令人失望。
/抱怨结束

items.text:
In a few billion years, our nearest star which is named "Sol" but which we colloquially refer to as "the sun", will die and so will all life on our planet Earth. At some point in the unfathomably far future, so will the entire universe, along with all life that may exist on other planets in other galaxies. No matter what we do or where we go, mankind and all other life will be gone, making everything we say or do utterly pointless in the grand scheme of things.

So it is with everything you do in Ostranauts. Sure, you may die from simple things like dehydration, starvation or asphyxiation, but technically you don't need to be in space for those. This game lets you die (or get hopelessly stuck) because of all sorts of [i]other[/i] reasons, such as drifting helplessly off because your RCS thrusters are inoperable, hypo- or hyperthermia, explosions, collisions, or the more exotic ones where you're missing a part to fix your Nav Console so you just can't [i]fly[/i] anywhere, or the stupidest way I failed so far; getting randomly slapped with a ticket for a "busted tail light" and then docking to buy food only to find that I can't undock again until I've paid the fine that might as well have been for a gazillion megadollars. Or crashing into a derelict because you run out of RCS fuel at the wrong moment. The list goes on.

I expected the game to be hard, but I wasn't expecting the UI to have me carefully hover the mouse over each pixel of a derelict vessel in search for the elusive component part that might postpone my inevitable death by a few minutes, all while my batteries slowly drain, my stomach grumbles, my O2 and N2 supplies trickle away and CO2 is building up. After half a dozen attempts with new characters, I'm nowhere near getting all the prerequisite parts and resources needed to even attempt to fire up a reactor that would postpone me dying from a dead ship battery. The closest I've been is a ship that had sturdy walls (and doors!), an only slightly broken reactor... and very little else unless you count the three different bathrooms. One of those prerequisites is a battery so I found one on another vessel, carefully restored to 100% and after I had installed it the charge remained steady at 60% for a few minutes... before it immediately drained in less than a minute for no obvious reason. On the other hand, I've become quite good at docking, undocking and uninstalling doors, because that's basically how I spend 90% of the time in the game. Trying to find stuff on derelict ships where the only thing that seems to work are the door locks. The starter guides that recommend you get a crowbar must be for an earlier version of the game. UPDATE: You can only PRY doors that aren't DAMAGED. If it's damaged then you have to either SCRAP it (faster but the door is destroyed) or UNINSTALL it (slower but you can fix it later).

In a word, the game feels hopeless. If there's a story somewhere that perhaps suggests a path through the dark void, it had better kick in soon or I'll conclude that the game, just like the universe itself, is without meaning and only lets you decide how much you want to struggle before you inevitably die. With another bogus ticket just to rub it in.

On the plus side, the sound design and music is solid.

UPDATE: A recent patch fixed the AI behaviour so the cops don't seem quite as eager to ram the player, instead they circle around you for a while in case you undock, then they give up and bugger off. A much needed improvement. The devs seem very active in the Steam forum and has been very helpful in offering tips and advice.

So... it turns out that the massive terminal named "WE BUY SCRAP" is [b]not[/b] where you're actually supposed to sell your scrap, instead you either buy a 24h scrapping license from the "LICENSEES ONLY" terminal for $5000 and sell there -OR- you use the Transit terminal, find an NPC referred to as "the Fixer" (one of the two with a trade option) and then persuade them to trade with you. Having already found a non-working fusion reactor and repaired it, then placed it in a zone on my ship tagged as a "barter zone", I could then sell the first one for well over 100k and the second one for around 70k. I guess the price is affected by supply and demand. Anyway, this made the game a little less hopeless as I'm now atleast able to dock regularly to recharge the battery and sell stuff, as well as make regular downpayments on the mortgage.

Finally, in one case I was able to talk myself out of a ticket (it only took me a little over an hour!) by befriending the officer, then finally "asking about the evidence locker" and turning down their offer of some free booze.

I absolutely hate the dialogue system, having to spend literally hours just going in circles (asking "how they're doing" 50 times in a single chat is apparently perfectly normal) but at least I've been able to see some of the game and expand my starter ship a little. Changing my review to a VERY cautious "Yes" but be warned: It doesn't matter how patient you think you are, you [i]will[/i] get frustrated with this game.
items.text_zh:
在几十亿年后，我们最近的恒星，名为“Sol”，但我们口语中称之为“太阳”，将会死亡，我们地球上的所有生命也将随之消亡。在某个难以想象的遥远未来，整个宇宙，以及其他星系中其他行星上可能存在的所有生命，也将如此。无论我们做什么或去哪里，人类和所有其他生命都将消失，使得我们所说或所做的一切在宏大的格局中变得毫无意义。

在《Ostranauts》中你所做的一切也是如此。当然，你可能会因为脱水、饥饿或窒息等简单原因而死，但严格来说，这些并不需要身处太空。这款游戏让你因为各种[i]其他[/i]原因而死亡（或陷入绝望的困境），比如因为你的RCS推进器失灵而无助地飘走，低体温或高体温，爆炸，碰撞，或者更离奇的情况，比如你缺少一个零件来修理导航控制台，所以你根本无法[i]飞[/i]到任何地方，或者是我迄今为止失败的最愚蠢方式：被随机开了一张“尾灯损坏”的罚单，然后停靠去买食物，却发现除非付清罚款，否则无法再次脱离停靠，而那罚款简直像是要付无数兆美元。或者因为在错误的时间耗尽RCS燃料而撞上一艘废弃飞船。这样的例子不胜枚举。

我预料到游戏会很难，但我没想到UI会让我仔细地将鼠标悬停在废弃飞船的每一个像素上，寻找那个可能将我不可避免的死亡推迟几分钟的 elusive 组件，而与此同时我的电池在慢慢耗尽，我的肚子在咕咕叫，我的O2和N2供应在一点点减少，CO2在积聚。在用了新角色尝试了半打之后，我离获得所有先决零件和资源还差得远，甚至无法尝试启动一个反应堆来推迟因飞船电池耗尽而死亡。我最接近的一次是一艘有坚固墙壁（还有门！）的飞船，一个只是稍微损坏的反应堆……以及除此之外几乎没有别的东西，除非你把三个不同的卫生间算上。其中一个先决条件是一块电池，所以我在另一艘飞船上找到了一块，小心地恢复到100%，安装后电荷在几分钟内稳定在60%……然后就在不到一分钟内毫无明显原因地立即耗尽了。另一方面，我已经变得相当擅长停靠、脱离停靠和拆卸门，因为这基本上就是我在游戏中90%的时间所做的事情。试图在废弃飞船上寻找东西，而那里唯一似乎能用的就是门锁。推荐你拿撬棍的新手指南肯定是针对游戏早期版本的。更新：你只能撬开没有损坏的门。如果门损坏了，那么你要么必须将其报废（更快但门会被摧毁），要么将其卸载（更慢但你可以稍后修复）。

总之，这款游戏让人感到绝望。如果某个地方有一个故事，也许暗示了一条穿过黑暗虚空的道路，它最好快点出现，否则我会得出结论：这款游戏，就像宇宙本身一样，毫无意义，只让你决定在不可避免的死亡之前你想挣扎多久。再加上另一张虚假罚单来雪上加霜。

好的一面是，音效设计和音乐很扎实。

更新：最近的一个补丁修复了AI行为，所以警察似乎不那么急于撞击玩家，相反，他们会在你周围盘旋一段时间，以防你脱离停靠，然后他们放弃并滚开。一个急需的改进。开发者似乎在Steam论坛上非常活跃，并在提供提示和建议方面非常 helpful。

所以……事实证明，那个名为“WE BUY SCRAP”的巨大终端[i]并不是[/i]你实际应该出售废料的地方，相反，你要么从“LICENSEES ONLY”终端花5000美元购买24小时废料处理许可证并在那里出售——或者——你使用Transit终端，找到一个被称为“the Fixer”的NPC（两个有交易选项的人之一），然后说服他们与你交易。在已经找到并修复了一个不工作的聚变反应堆，然后将其放置在我飞船上标记为“以物易物区”的区域后，我可以将第一个卖到远超10万，第二个卖到大约7万。我猜价格受供需影响。不管怎样，这让游戏稍微不那么绝望了，因为我现在至少能够定期停靠来给电池充电和卖东西，以及定期支付抵押贷款。

最后，有一次我能够通过和警官交朋友，然后最终“询问证据柜”并拒绝他们提供的一些免费酒水，从而说服自己免于一张罚单（只花了我一个多小时！）。

我绝对讨厌对话系统，不得不花上几个小时只是原地打转（在一次聊天中问“他们过得怎么样”50次显然是完全正常的），但至少我能够看到游戏的一些内容，并稍微扩展了我的初始飞船。将我的评测改为非常谨慎的“是”，但请注意：无论你认为自己多有耐心，你[i]会[/i]对这款游戏感到沮丧。
改进。开发者似乎在Steam论坛上非常活跃，并且在提供提示和建议方面非常乐于助人。

所以……事实证明，那个名为“我们收购废料”的大型终端[b]并不是[/b]你实际应该出售废料的地方，相反，你要么从“仅限持证者”终端花5000美元购买24小时废料回收许可证并在那里出售——或者——你使用中转终端，找到一个被称为“中间人”的NPC（两个有交易选项的人之一），然后说服他们与你交易。在已经找到一台无法运作的聚变反应堆并修复它，然后把它放在我船上标记为“以物易物区”的区域后，我就能把第一台卖到远超10万，第二台卖到大约7万。我猜价格受供需影响。总之，这让游戏稍微没那么绝望了，因为我现在至少能够定期停靠来给电池充电并卖东西，还能定期偿还抵押贷款。

最后，有一次我能够通过和警官交朋友，然后最终“询问证物柜”，并拒绝他们提供的一些免费酒水，从而说服自己免掉了一张罚单（只花了我一个多小时！）。

我绝对讨厌这个对话系统，不得不花上好几个小时只是原地打转（在一次聊天里问50次“他们过得怎么样”显然完全正常），但至少我得以看到游戏的一些内容，并稍微扩展了我的初始飞船。把我的评测改成非常谨慎的“是”，但请注意：无论你认为自己多有耐心，你[i]都会[/i]对这款游戏感到沮丧。
